title: 8-type electric flux tube solutions in SU(3) gauge theory
summary: We consider electric flux tube solutions in SU(3) gauge theory with scalar fields in the fundamental representation, for an electric field in the $λ_8$ direction (8-type). In temporal gauge, the 3-type electric field rotates within a single SU(2) subgroup at one frequency, whereas the 8-type electric field necessarily rotates within three SU(2) subgroups with at least two different frequencies.
